subject: Invoice origin & fallback routing — portal opt-in with email copies
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@cobalt-analytics.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts-payable@cobalt-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Who will be sending invoices (email vs portal)?

Hi Tessa,

Quick question from AP: for Cobalt's account, who will originate monthly invoices — will Redwood push invoices into our portal or do you send PDFs by email? We need to know the canonical sender for PO matching and VAT tagging. Also: do you provide VAT evidence with the invoice or as a separate document?

We have a PO (PO-88931) that needs to be matched. If you can confirm preferred delivery and whether we should expect an e-invoice or PDF, we can map it into our system.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Accounting Manager
Cobalt Analytics

---
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@cobalt-analytics.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Who will be sending invoices (email vs portal)?

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick note and the PO number. Short answer: we support both, and we usually recommend opting into the Redwood Billing Portal for ongoing customers (portal is canonical).

Suggested flow: 
- Primary: Redwood Billing Portal (API push) as the canonical invoice emitter — this ensures machine-readable payloads (xml/json) for AP matching.
- Secondary: PDF copy by email (accounts-payable@cobalt-analytics.com) for your human reviewers and archive retention.

If you opt into the portal we'll:
- Register Cobalt's billing contact and send a billing-contact form (DocuSign) to confirm remit and VAT details.
- Push the first invoice via API within our monthly cut (GMT 00:00) and email a PDF copy same-day.
- Keep a fallback: if API/portal push fails, we will email the PDF from billing@redwood.ai and notify your AP team and our CS contact.

VAT evidence: we include VAT registration numbers and a VAT summary section on the invoice PDF; if you need separate certificates (e.g., reverse-charge evidence), we can attach those as a follow-up.

I'll loop in Connor (billing ops) to confirm the fallback SLA and kim (partnerships) to track onboarding. Can you confirm the AP contact who will accept DocuSign and whether the PO should appear on the invoice line?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0142

Attachment: sample_invoice_Q2-2025.pdf (sample formatting)

Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 08:22:00 -0700

Hi Tessa — thanks, portal-first sounds good. A couple of details from our side: 
- AP contact for DocuSign: accounts-payable@cobalt-analytics.com (monitored by our AP team).
- Please include PO-88931 on the invoice line (we need the PO on both the machine payload and the PDF).
- We require VAT number on the invoice and prefer VAT evidence attached for any reverse-charge lines.

We'd like the PDF emailed to accounts-payable@cobalt-analytics.com plus a CC to elena.martinez@cobalt-analytics.com for the first month while we validate.

Also: if the portal push fails, please CC our AP Ops alias and include a short failure reason in the body — that helps auto-reconciliation.

Thanks — looking forward to the DocuSign form.
Elena

Hi Elena — Connor from Billing Ops here. Thanks for the clear preferences — we'll set Cobalt up as follows: 

1) Portal enrollment: we will provision the billing account for Cobalt and trigger the DocuSign billing_contact_form.docx to accounts-payable@cobalt-analytics.com today. Please sign the form; it confirms remit, VAT number, and desired email copies. Link: https://docusign.example.com/--/billing-contact-CBA-2025-087

2) First push schedule: once the form is signed we'll push the initial invoice for the July cycle via API (machine payload includes PO field, VAT tag, currencies). On the same day the system will email a PDF to accounts-payable@cobalt-analytics.com and CC elena.martinez@cobalt-analytics.com as requested.

3) Fallback policy (brief): if portal/API push returns >2 transient errors or is unavailable for the daily scheduled job, our system automatically fails over to manual PDF email from billing@redwood.ai with an explanatory header; internal ops will open a ticket and notify Cobalt's AP alias. The fallback is logged and retained for 90 days for audit.

4) VAT evidence: we will attach a VAT-summary PDF where reverse-charge applies. If Cobalt needs a separate certificate we'll attach it as a follow-up.

I've attached the billing contact form and a local sample invoice for review. If everything looks good I'll schedule a 15-min kickoff with our onboarding engineer to confirm the connector fields.

Best regards,
Connor O'Brien
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
